items.headline: Anthropic files to go public on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT"
items.summary: Anthropic filed paperwork (called an S-1) with the SEC for an initial public offering, meaning it plans to sell shares to the public. The share price and number of shares aren't set yet, and nothing can be bought until the filing is approved.
items.why_it_matters: For anyone building a business on Claude, this signals the company is aiming for long-term staying power, and the public filing should eventually reveal how the business is doing.
